{{Quote|Fanatical isolationists, led by a zealot who calls himself 'The Conservator.' He preaches that non-native influence is poison to Manaan's virtues. The extremists attack any Selkath who associate with 'outsiders.'&thinsp;|[[Shak Los]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
'''The Conservator''', also known as '''The Caretaker of Manaan''', was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Together, my people and I protect the seas from outsiders. We fight to keep our home and its innocent creatures free from harm... ...even if it means we must take up arms against other Selkath. My people heed my commands because our beliefs are as one. I have earned their devotion. They will continue my work, even when I am gone.|The Conservator|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
The Conservator was a member of the Selkath isolationist group [[Syphus Collective]], which followed the teachings of [[Narlan Syphus]].<ref name="The Conservator" /> By [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> the Conservator had gained control of the Syphus Collective and stopped using his real name. The circumstances surrounding his rise to leader are unclear, and many thought he used assassination to climb the ranks. During the [[Invasion of Manaan]], both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] considered him a nuisance,<ref name="The Conservator" /> and the Empire sent [[Krallet Division]] to deal with him and his organization, but they failed. The Selkath artifact smuggler [[Shak Los]] wanted the Conservator dealt with so he could raid the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] (which the Syphus Collective were using as a base) for artifacts to smuggle off-world.<ref name="TOR:ACP" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the Conservator is only directly confronted if the player sides with the Imperials, where Shak Los sends the player on a mission to clear out the Temple of the Progenitor in exchange for a map to [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] supplies. During that quest, the player has the option to kill the Conservator or turn him into a spy for the Empire.<ref name="TOR:ACP" />
